# Botrun 波特人

> Botrun 波特人是台灣卡米爾公司開發的 AI 平台。
> 上傳 PDF 建立知識庫問答、不寫程式建立自訂 Bot、支援地端部署。
> 政府部會（內政部、數位部、法務部）與企業已導入使用。

## 頁面索引

- [首頁](https://docs.botrun.ai): Botrun 波特人是台灣卡米爾公司開發的企業 AI 平台。上傳 PDF 建立知識庫問答、一鍵建立自訂 Bot、支援地端部署資料不外洩。政府部會、企業都在用。
- [功能](https://docs.botrun.ai/features/index.html): 波特人（Botrun）平台完整功能列表。從聊天對話、Bot 建立、知識庫問答、語音轉文字、MCP 工具整合到地端部署，了解每個功能能幫你解決什麼問題。
- [導入指南](https://docs.botrun.ai/getting-started/index.html): 了解如何將波特人（Botrun）導入你的組織。從發現評估、高品味題庫、黑客松實作到教育訓練上線，完整的導入旅程與真實政府部會案例。
- [FAQ](https://docs.botrun.ai/faq/index.html): 關於 Botrun 波特人平台的常見問題與解答：什麼是波特人、免費試用、定價方式、與 ChatGPT 差異。
- [原生波特人](https://docs.botrun.ai/features/native.html): 波特人原生功能完整說明：即時搜尋、PDF 深度分析、多圖辨識、AI 圖片生成、互動式圖表、流程圖、客製化網頁、語音輸入。進入 botrun.ai 即可使用。
- [孵化器](https://docs.botrun.ai/features/hatcher.html): 波特人孵化器完整指南：Bot 建立、提示工程、知識庫 RAG、MCP 工具整合、多代理模式。含真實案例（內政部波孵）。
- [平台能力](https://docs.botrun.ai/features/platform.html): 波特人平台能力完整說明：Bot 分享與協作、.botrun 編譯匯出、地端部署、帳號設定與安全機制。
- [高品味題庫](https://docs.botrun.ai/getting-started/knowledge-base.html): 什麼是高品味題庫？六欄位結構、建立步驟、與傳統 Prompt Engineering 的差異。含國科會公文、法務部法規智慧入口真實案例。
- [黑客松實作](https://docs.botrun.ai/getting-started/hackathon.html): 波特人黑客松三種級別（體驗場、實作場、深度場），事前準備、現場流程、事後跟進。含內政部宗禮司真實案例。
- [教育訓練與優化](https://docs.botrun.ai/getting-started/training.html): 波特人教育訓練三種方式（無人教室、現場訓練、三堂必修課）、上線檢查清單、持續優化與組織擴展策略。
- [功能與技術](https://docs.botrun.ai/faq/advanced.html): Botrun 波特人進階常見問答：支援檔案格式、AI 模型選擇、TAIDE、.botrun 格式、資料安全、對話介面功能、提示詞技巧。

## English Pages

- [Home](https://docs.botrun.ai/en/): Botrun is an enterprise AI platform developed by CAMEO INC. in Taiwan. Upload PDFs to build knowledge base Q&A, create custom Bots with one click, supports on-premise deployment to keep data secure. Used by government agencies and enterprises.
- [Features](https://docs.botrun.ai/en/features/index.html): Complete feature list of the Botrun platform. From AI chat, Bot building, knowledge base Q&A, speech-to-text, MCP tool integration to on-premise deployment — discover how each feature solves your problems.
- [Getting Started](https://docs.botrun.ai/en/getting-started/index.html): Learn how to deploy Botrun in your organization. A complete journey from discovery and evaluation, Quality Question Bank, hackathon validation to training and launch, with real government agency case studies.
- [FAQ](https://docs.botrun.ai/en/faq/index.html): Frequently asked questions about Botrun: What is Botrun, free trial, pricing, and how it compares to ChatGPT.
- [Native Botrun](https://docs.botrun.ai/en/features/native.html): Complete guide to Botrun's native features: real-time search, PDF deep analysis, multi-image recognition, AI image generation, interactive charts, flowcharts, custom web pages, and voice input. Available instantly at botrun.ai.
- [Hatcher (Bot Builder)](https://docs.botrun.ai/en/features/hatcher.html): Complete guide to Botrun Hatcher: Bot creation, prompt engineering, knowledge base RAG, MCP tool integration, and multi-agent mode. Includes real-world case study (Taiwan Ministry of the Interior).
- [Platform Capabilities](https://docs.botrun.ai/en/features/platform.html): Botrun platform capabilities: Bot sharing and collaboration, .botrun compilation export, on-premise deployment, account settings, and security features.
- [Quality Question Bank](https://docs.botrun.ai/en/getting-started/knowledge-base.html): What is a Quality Question Bank? Six-field structure, building steps, and differences from traditional Prompt Engineering. Includes real case studies from the National Science and Technology Council and Ministry of Justice.
- [Hackathon](https://docs.botrun.ai/en/getting-started/hackathon.html): Botrun hackathon three levels (Experience, Workshop, Deep Dive), preparation, on-site process, and follow-up. Includes a real case study from the Ministry of Interior.
- [Training & Optimization](https://docs.botrun.ai/en/getting-started/training.html): Botrun training three methods (Self-paced Learning, On-site Training, Three Required Courses), go-live checklist, continuous optimization and organizational scaling strategy.
- [Features & Technical](https://docs.botrun.ai/en/faq/advanced.html): Botrun advanced FAQ: supported file formats, AI model selection, TAIDE, data security, chat interface features, and prompt engineering tips.
